chunks: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Yahya al-Mad'ani, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) used to ride on a red quilt (or saddle-cloth).

key_terms.عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ: Ali ibn al-Husayn, the fourth Imam, known as Zayn al-Abidin
key_terms.قَطِيفَةٍ: A quilted saddle-cloth or covering for a beast of burden

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn ride on according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This brief narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the modesty and simplicity of Imam Zayn al-Abidin, illustrating that even the Ahl al-Bayt adhered to the Sunnah of avoiding ostentation in their personal attire and mounts. It serves as a practical model for Shia jurisprudence regarding the permissibility of using simple, non-luxurious materials for riding gear, reinforcing the virtue of humility in daily conduct.
